messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/quotas — a few concrete questions so we have one canonical answer here. :memo:

matt: Go ahead, will answer each.

elaine: 1) If a customer upgrades mid-cycle, do new quotas apply immediately? 2) Do promo/one-off credits scale up?
sophia: 1) New quotas and rate-limit targets are applied at provision time; most upgrades are live <5m but routing enforces previous limits until provisioning completes. 2) Promo credits are account-level tokens and do NOT auto-scale; they remain at their original value and TTL.

elaine: If we gave an outage buffer (temporary tokens) and they switch to Dedicated, does the buffer persist?
matt: Yes — buffers are attached to the account_id and persist until their TTL, regardless of plan changes. We log buffer_id on the billing bucket.

riley: Note: for fallthrough routing to cheaper variants, the billed model_id is the one actually served. So customers may see different per-token costs if we route to a variant.

andre: We added a policy: if fallthrough changes unit price by >10% customers receive an account event and a billing note; they can opt to disable automatic fallthrough in settings.

elaine: Streaming billing — if a stream is cut by rate limit mid-response, what's billed?
riley: Tokens are billed at flush/commit boundaries. If cut mid-stream, only flushed tokens are billed. We return headers like X-Stream-Flushed-Tokens and X-RateLimit-Remaining.

sam: Finance: consumed credits are not reclaimed on downgrade. Refunds for unused committed capacity are handled by billing ops per contract.

elaine: Launch day spikes — temporary quota increases path?
sophia: Console self-serve for temporary quota requests ships mid-May. Until then, use support with tag "quota-increase" and include expected RPS/duration. Example payload in support note.
matt: Ops SLA: typical approvals within 24h if telemetry attached, 48h for multi-region.

elaine: Do our managed health checks count toward customer quotas? Customers asked about probes eating credits.
riley: Managed health probes from our probe IPs and using agent keys are excluded. Customer-originated checks do count; recommend using the low-cost monitoring endpoint.

billing-bot: Task created: BILL-534 - add Console copy about fallthrough and set up alert triggers.

elaine: Great, I'll add this Q&A to the all-hands notes and link the BILL ticket. Thanks!
